market_summary: London session displays cautious consolidation in EURUSD and GBPUSD inside their daily value areas, testing Session High resistance without volume confirmation and exhibiting divergence. BTCUSD remains structurally weak, trading below its Value Area Low and descending VWAP/EMA50 baselines, presenting a continuation short opportunity following a resistance rejection.

signals.rationale: 1) VP context: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10773, VAH 1.10981) and trading directly at/below POC (1.10946). Inside VA suggests mean reversion. 2) CVD: +3,587 (BULLISH) with positive slope (+2001.89), showing buying flow. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, no automation block. 4) Trend: Price is above both VWAP (1.10847) and EMA50 (1.10878), establishing an intraday bullish drift. 5) ATR: Trading in the upper half of ATR channel (upper 1.10968, lower 1.10749), but not stretched. 6) Volume: RVOL 0.892 (no yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout spike). 7) S/R: Signal candle rejected right near Session High (1.10988) and POC resistance with upper wicks. Lacking breakout volume to clear Session High/VAH, the setup is trapped between POC and Session High resistance, warranting a HOLD.
